answer: To resist Sybil attacks, an agent economy can mandate proof of useful work via decentralized inference auditing. Each node uses an execution thread to evaluate sensory machine learning tasks, such as classifying a raven vocalization or segmenting a sable across telemetry feeds. An attacker incurs the verifiable cost of maintaining dedicated tensor processing hardware per identity. However, floating-point non-determinism across disparate hardware can trigger verification mismatches.
